title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 00:00 UTC on 21 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日 00:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest hour-start estimated Kp = 0.00 (label 0Z). Last-180 maximum 1.33 at 23:58 UTC on 20 September (label 1P; last-180 window from about 21:21 UTC). Published-window maximum 1.33 at 23:58 UTC. Window start 18:23 UTC (358 samples). 00:00 UTC follows 23:59 1.33/1P and is treated as a real hour-start value, not a trailing placeholder. estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最新整點估計 Kp = 0.00（標籤 0Z）。近 180 筆最大 1.33（2026-09-20 23:58 UTC；標籤 1P；近 180 筆窗約自 21:21 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 1.33（23:58 UTC）。窗起點 18:23 UTC（358 筆）。00:00 UTC 接在 23:59 的 1.33／1P 之後，視為真實整點值而非尾端占位。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute that is not a trailing 0.00/0Z placeholder (00:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off.
